## History

Tillie Boulter is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. She attends afternoon lessons under the instruction of schoolmaster Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md).

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--tillie-boulter.md)

Tillie is a classmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). During a school incident involving Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), Tillie took Anne's side.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)_
